entry.name: showPercentage
entry.label: If true, the battery will display a little charge percentage label inside.

entry.name: useLevelColors
entry.label: Color the fill by the charge level instead of the Plasma theme color

entry.name: colorHigh
entry.label: Fill color above the medium threshold

entry.name: colorMedium
entry.label: Fill color between the low and medium thresholds

entry.name: colorLow
entry.label: Fill color at or below the low threshold

entry.name: showChargingBolt
entry.label: Show a lightning bolt instead of the number while charging

entry.name: fontSizePt
entry.label: Font size of the percentage in points; 0 means automatic
